Name: Cooking Spices
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

This is a Content Patcher content pack for Custom Seasonings that adds the following items to the game that can be added as seasoning when cooking dishes:
[list]
[*]Rock Salt - adds a +1 mining buff[/*]
[*]Sea Salt - adds a +1 fishing buff[/*]
[*]Sage - adds a +1 luck buff[/*]
[*]Basil - adds a +1 foraging buff[/*]
[*]Cayenne - adds a +1 Attack buff[/*]
[*]Fenugreek - adds a +1 Defence buff[/*]
[*]Rosemary - adds a +1 farming buff[/*]
[/list]The content pack also enables adding garlic (+1 magnetic radius) and ginger (2x Crit Chance Mult buff) when cooking dishes.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires Content Patcher and Custom Seasoning.

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
